note: Working names (the writing draft) and roles from the PRD. name is what dialogue name plates and date cards say; role is the subline. The shrine keeper's personality and bet are still open. Each villager wishes for one thing about their home (specs/town.md section 5): next to the sea, or next to one of wish_buildings (sharing an edge).

items.name: Isoko
items.bet_lost: Their breath: they can no longer dive
items.wish_line: I can't dive any more, but I still want to hear the waves.

items.name: Genzo
items.wish_text: Next to the Boat shed or the Net shed
items.wish_line: Put me near the boats. I sleep better with the smell of tar.

items.name: Chiyo
items.wish_text: Next to the Hot Spring or a Tea stall
items.wish_line: Somewhere warm, with tea close by. Is that so much to ask?

items.name: Akane
items.wish_line: A lantern by the door, please. Spirits like to know where I live.
